P.text: A Vault account holds Portfolio Margin supplied collateral on HyperCore (precompile 0x811) and can also owe USDC borrow debt against eligible collateral.
P.evidence_quote: A Vault account can therefore owe USDC borrow debt while Monetrix still reports the supplied collateral as full backing.

I.text: The Accountant's backing calculation must subtract Portfolio Margin borrow debt (borrow.value) from supplied balances so that surplus reflects net backing.
I.evidence_quote: Monetrix adds the supply side into `_readL1Backing()` but never subtracts `borrow.value`.

V.text: The Accountant counts supplied balances but omits borrow debt, producing false surplus that is bridged, settled, and distributed as yield, leaving USDM undercollateralized.
V.evidence_quote: This creates false surplus. The normal yield flow can bridge, settle, and distribute that false surplus as yield, leaving USDM undercollateralized by the ignored borrow.
